newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to sell 20-year T-bonds on April 22.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to sell 20-year T-bonds on April 22.

text.p: The Philippines has slated the sale of its maiden issue of 20-year Treasury bonds on April 22, National Treasurer Caridad Valdehuesa told Reuters on Monday.
She said Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo had already given the go-ahead on the timing of the sale of the issue.
The first batch of 20-year T-bonds will amount to two billion pesos and will be issued every six months, she said.
She added the Philippines will be the first country from among its Asian neighbours to float Treasury bonds with a 20-year maturity.
Last year, the government sold its first issue of seven-year bonds in January and ten-year bonds in September.
The government had been lengthening the profile of its debt in order to help lower interest rates and provide a benchmark for longer-term borrowings for banks.
